limitations: Snapshots cover only explicitly attached portions and coordinator terminal collection is pending.
Cached input is part of input, not an additional quantity; tokens are host-reported, not provider authenticated.
Activity clocks are reporter-declared; pauses exclude known waits, not a measurement of model compute.

Final acceptance, administrative checks and conversation tail occur after the frozen coordinator clock.
